visualEvidence.observation: RU start screen is readable with no critical overlap; the portrait placeholder leaves the dialogue card clear.
RU choice screen shows both touch targets, readable wrapping, and safe spacing above the action row.
Terminal screen keeps the final paragraph inside the card and leaves Back/New Game accessible.
English start screen preserves the same composition and readable control labels.

decision: MOBILE_UI_ADVISORY: PARTIAL. Readability, composition, touch-target sizing, and responsive layout are acceptable in the supplied states; full mobile acceptance remains open for runtime touch/orientation checks. Production-art acceptance is not evaluated.

findings.detail: The first choice screenshot was captured before choice buttons were visible; the current 390x844 receipt was re-captured with both choices present.
The disabled completion button has lower contrast than active controls; the separate status line remains visible.

unresolved: actual touch areas and orientation-change behavior require runtime verification
limitations: advisory screenshot review only; no artistic acceptance and no Concept Proof decision
